judgments.reason: The span 'Large confluent anterior cervical osteophytes from C2–T1' appears literally in the CT neck findings and directly supports the cervical osteophyte component of the diagnosis label.
The span 'progressive dysphagia, first to solids and then to liquids' appears literally in the presenting history and directly supports the dysphagia complication modifier in the completed label.
The span 'Extrinsic compression of upper esophagus' appears literally in the EGD findings and clinically supports dysphagia as a complication of cervical osteophytes compressing the esophagus.
